Class TextConfiguration

java.lang.Object
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.config.TextConfiguration
public final class TextConfiguration extends Object
Loads client text settings and updates their registered colors and effects together.

This class tracks one configuration batch for the process. read(Path) reads a file into TextConfiguration.Settings; apply(Settings) validates its descriptors and installs them. Each successful apply replaces the previous batch installed by this class, whether it came from the standalone file or a host mod.

Cleanup removes the exact bindings from the earlier batch. Unrelated registrations remain, while a new entry with the same kind and exact trigger follows the registry's replacement rules. If validation or registration fails, the previous configuration batch stays active.

The standalone client uses config/chromatic_codes.cfg. A host can call useExternalConfiguration() to stop the standalone listener, then read its own file and pass settings to apply. The switch itself neither reads nor installs settings. These settings control local text presentation and do not synchronize server gameplay.

    • useExternalConfiguration

      public static void useExternalConfiguration()
      Stops the standalone listener from applying its file for the rest of this process.

      This one-way switch does not read a host file or change existing definitions. The host must read its settings and call apply(Settings) on the initial load and later reloads. Direct calls to read(Path) and apply remain available after the switch.

    • isExternallyManaged

      public static boolean isExternallyManaged()
      Tests whether a host has disabled standalone file application for this process.
      Returns:
      true after the first host takeover request

    • apply

      public static void apply(TextConfiguration.Settings settings)
      Validates every entry, then replaces this configuration's bindings and options in one registry edit.

      All descriptors are parsed before preparing the edit. Failed validation or registration leaves the previous batch active. The named-case and inline-code flags affect the shared registry; its default outline color is retained. An entry can replace another registration with the same kind and exact trigger.

      Parameters:
      settings - complete non-null text settings batch
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any descriptor, factory option or trigger is invalid
      NullPointerException - if settings is null

    • validate

      public static void validate(TextConfiguration.Settings settings)
      Checks a complete draft without publishing definitions or changing registry options. Movement constructors run during validation, just as they do during application.
      Parameters:
      settings - immutable draft to check on the calling thread
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any descriptor, duplicate trigger or effect setting is invalid
      NullPointerException - if settings is null

    • read

      public static TextConfiguration.Settings read(Path target) throws IOException
      Reads standalone defaults or existing preferences without rewriting existing bytes/unknown keys.

      This validates file structure and property shapes/types, creates a default file only when missing, and returns copied settings. It does not install definitions. Pass the result to apply(Settings) to validate descriptor contents and publish the complete batch.

      Parameters:
      target - configuration path; missing parent directories and defaults can be created
      Returns:
      immutable text settings mapped from the file
      Throws:
      IOException - if reading, strict validation, or create-only default publication fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if a setting has an invalid declared type or value
